text: Install the Formant agent on a device using a Docker-based installer, including on ROS1 devices
quote: Install the Formant agent on a ROS1 device by running the Docker-based installer.

text: Agent SDK lets on-device code ingest telemetry, receive and respond to commands, and teleoperate the device
quote: The Agent SDK client contains a suite of methods which allow you to ingest telemetry data, receive and respond to commands, teleoperate your device, and more.

text: Python Cloud SDK lets data scientists query telemetry data through the query API
quote: The primary programmatic way data scientists query for telemetry data is via the Cloud SDK, a lightweight Python module which can interact with the query API.

text: Create custom commands through the Formant Admin API
quote: In addition to these commands, you can create custom commands via the Formant Admin API.

text: Build your own applications on Formant's APIs and RealtimeSDK
quote: Create your own application that uses Formant's APIs and RealtimeSDK for data

text: Custom modules can work with multiple devices together in group views
quote: Modules can now work with multiple devices in coherence group views

text: Fleet-wide visibility with anomaly alerts, mission progress tracking, and issue response
quote: Get instant visibility into every robot in your fleet. Set up alerts for anomalies, track mission progress, and respond to issues before they become downtime.

text: Low-latency peer-to-peer teleoperation via joystick, buttons, or custom controls
quote: Reliable, low-latency teleoperation over a peer-to-peer connection keeps your operations moving — via joystick, buttons, or custom controls.

text: Build device dashboards using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or an AI assistant
quote: Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.

text: Track historical performance per robot and per mission alongside current location and status
quote: Tracks historical performance per robot, per mission — speed, error rates, how a given unit has handled a given job before — alongside current location and status.

text: Assign jobs to the best-suited robot across vendors using operational history and live data
quote: Heterogeneous Fleet Orchestration assigns the right job to the right robot — regardless of who built it — using operational history and live data, and dispatches help the moment something looks wrong.

text: Commands trigger predefined robot actions such as data ingestion, running scripts, or returning home
quote: Commands tell our robot to take a predefined action. For example, we can use commands to trigger data ingestion, run a script, or tell our robot to return to its home position.

text: Connect multiple robot types and normalize ingested data so it is uniform and searchable
quote: Easily connect to multiple robot types with minimal lift. Ensure all data ingested is uniform and searchable.

text: Configure teleop interfaces for a specific use case
quote: Configure teleop interfaces to meet the needs of your specific use case.

text: Ask the fleet questions in plain language and get ML-driven task recommendations that people approve
quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.

text: Time-synced video, sensor, and intervention records available to your team
quote: Time-synced video, sensor, and intervention records for your team, and, where you choose, scoped research partnerships.

text: Configure devices, design custom views and modules, and build backends for custom applications via APIs and SDKs
quote: Formant's APIs and SDKs which allow you to programmatically ingest data, configure devices, design custom views and modules

text: UI custom elements that match the look of Formant's ecosystem
quote: UI custom elements to make your application visually look similar to Formant's ecosystem

text: Teleoperation over a secure peer-to-peer connection that lets operators control any aspect of a system
quote: Formant's teleoperation provides a secure peer-to-peer connection that enables operators to control any aspect of a system.

text: Real-time remote control over a WebRTC peer-to-peer connection between device and web app
quote: allows you to remotely control your device via a real-time, peer-to-peer connection between your device and the Formant web application over WebRTC.

text: Analytics to visualize, aggregate, and analyze device data over a chosen time range
quote: Formant Analytics allows you to visualize, aggregate, and analyze data from your device over a time range of your choice.

text: Analyze data for an individual device or for a fleet by device group or tag
quote: You can analyze from an individual device, or from a fleet of devices by device group or tag.

text: Automatically dispatch help the moment something looks wrong
quote: Assigns the right job to the right robot — regardless of who built it — using operational history and live data, and dispatches help the moment something looks wrong.

text: Automate incident response and create workflows for monitoring devices at scale
quote: Build better human-to-robot ratios by automating incident response and creating workflows for monitoring devices at scale.

text: A single view across multi-vendor fleets of AMRs, quadrupeds, humanoids, and arms
quote: One view across every vendor's fleet — AMRs, quadrupeds, humanoids, arms — without a separate dashboard, update cycle, or incident format per manufacturer.

text: Manage multiple fleets simultaneously from a single operator view
quote: Manage multiple fleets simultaneously from a single operator view

text: Embed your own application inside Formant, for example as a custom view
quote: Embed your own application in Formant

text: Ingest arbitrary data directly through the Cloud SDK ingestion API without needing an agent
quote: sometimes you may want to ingest directly without requiring an agent. The `ingest` method of the Formant Cloud SDK is a good option in those situations.

text: Webhooks that call any HTTP endpoint when a Formant event fires
quote: A webhook allows you to make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event.

text: Send commands with one click from the Observe view or during teleoperation
quote: We can send commands with the click of a button from the Observe view, or during teleoperation.

text: Use events to trigger commands automatically
quote: We can send commands with the click of a button from the Observe view, or during teleoperation. We can also use events to trigger commands

text: Create real-time visualizations of robots
quote: Create realtime visualizations of your robots

text: Rate-limit each data stream so data isn't ingested at unnecessarily high resolution
quote: Each data stream can be rate-limited, so you don't need to ingest data at high resolution if you don't need it.

text: Choose which data sources and streams are uploaded to the cloud
quote: You can configure which data sources and data streams are uploaded to the cloud.

text: Set a hard kbps ceiling on the agent's asset uploads with an environment variable
quote: Set `FORMANT_UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_KBPS` on the device to put a hard ceiling, in kilobits per second, on the agent's asset uploads

text: Low bandwidth mode that significantly cuts the agent's passive data usage
quote: you can put the formant-agent in low bandwidth mode. This significantly reduces the amount of data the formant-agent uses for its passive duties

text: Re-provision a device while keeping its Formant identity and link to existing data
quote: you can re-provision your device to maintain its Formant identity and relation to existing data. Data will then appear as though it is from the same device.

text: Mouse-click streams for image-based UIs, such as picking pixels or sending map locations
quote: You can use mouse click streams to create image-based UIs which can, for example, determine which pixel was clicked on the screen, or send locations on a map.

text: Teleop views can send mouse click locations to a ROS topic or API endpoint
quote: You can configure your teleoperation view to send the location of a mouse click to a ROS topic or API endpoint.

text: Control agent behavior through environment variables
quote: You can use environment variables to control Formant agent behavior.

text: Set custom directories for agent data operations
quote: This guide will teach you how to set custom directories for Formant agent data operations.

text: Export device configuration to YAML or save it as a reusable template
quote: export the configuration to a YAML (from the device configuration), or save the configuration as a template

text: The agent automatically restarts adapter commands, with no limit on restarts
quote: if you use adapters, the Formant agent will manage automatically restarting the specified command to run. No max number of restarts.

text: Forward a web page served on a remote device to localhost on your machine
quote: This forwards the page accessible at `webpageIP:port` from `<device_name>` to your local device at `localhost:1111`.

text: One governed platform connecting business systems, operations teams, AI, and robots from any vendor
quote: Formant connects business systems, operations teams, AI, and robots — from every vendor — into one governed platform

text: Durable message queue that delivers requests to a device immediately or when it next comes online
quote: A durable message queue is also maintained that can issue requests to your system either immediately or the next time it’s online

text: Built-in commands to fetch files from the device, publish to ROS topics, and run scripts
quote: `formant.get_file` Ingest a file from your device. `formant.publish_ros_topic` Publish a message to a ROS topic. `formant.run_script` Run a script on the device.

text: Build custom web and 3D experiences on Formant using ThreeJS
quote: With this repo's tools you can make custom web and 3D experiences on top of Formant using ThreeJS

text: Real-time fleet telemetry and status, with configurable alerts and automated incident detection
quote: Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet. Configurable alerts and automated incident detection

text: Edit the agent's ROS_MASTER_URI on the device and restart the agent to apply it
quote: The `ROS_MASTER_URI` is stored in the `/var/lib/formant/.bashrc` file on the device. You can edit this path and restart the agent.
